title: Hermes announcement feed
description: Messages the Hermes maintainers publish to the Web UI home page. Lives on the repository's `feed` branch as feed.json.

version.description: Feed format version. Bump only on a breaking format change.

id.description: Stable identifier. Dismissals are remembered per id, so never reuse an id for an unrelated announcement.

title.description: One-line headline. Plain text; markup is not rendered.

body.description: Optional detail. Plain text; line breaks are preserved, markup is not rendered.

level.description: Severity, which also sets the ordering: danger first, then warning, info, success.

channel.description: Which builds see this. `nightly` covers any build whose version carries a suffix (0.5.1+abc1234).

affects.description: Version range(s) this applies to. Clauses within one string are ANDed (">=0.5.0 <0.5.2"); a list is ORed. Build metadata is ignored, so 0.5.1 also covers every 0.5.1 nightly. Omit for all versions.

link.description: Optional http(s) link, typically the tracking issue. Any other scheme is discarded by the client.

starts.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp before which the message is hidden.

expires.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp from which the message is hidden. Prefer this over deleting an entry, so it disappears on its own.

dismissible.description: Whether a user can clear the message. Set false only for something that must stay put.

revision.description: Bump after editing a message to show it again to people who already dismissed it.
